name: Rayssa Bratillieri
bio: Rayssa Jordão Bratilieri Gomes, better known as Rayssa Bratillieri (Apucarana, November 11, 1997), is a Brazilian actress.

credits.title: Pecadora
credits.overview: Isabel is a very religious young woman whose life is transformed when she starts working with Enrico, a free-spirited and seductive man. As she tries to deny her attraction to her colleague and the awakening of her most forbidden desires, she finds herself confronting everything she always believed.

credits.title: Apaixonada
credits.overview: Based on the book by Cris Souza Fontes, Apaixonada tells the story of a woman who realizes how monotonous her life is. She finds herself desperate and facing an identity crisis. From then on, she is forced to begin an exciting journey of self-discovery that takes her close to all the passions that life has to offer.

credits.title: The Modelizer
credits.overview: A Hong Kong tycoon bachelor who only dates models meets his match when he stumbles across a Brazilian model who refuses to play by his rules, and ends up not only falling for her, but also discovering the meaning of love along the way.
